Samrudhi Lottery Result 2026: Prize Details

Samrudhi is one of the seven weekly lotteries. Samrudhi lottery draw is held every Sunday at 3 pm. Every lottery is represented by an alphabetical code, and the Samrudhi lottery code is “SM”, which contains the draw number along with the code. The Samrudhi lottery ticket costs Rs. 50 only.

Kerala State Lotteries Department releases the lottery in 12 series, and the series may vary. 108 lakh tickets were issued for sale every week. The first prize winner got 1 crore Rupees.

Kerala State Lotteries Results

Samrudhi's lottery ticket has 10 prizes, including a consolation prize. The first prize winner received 1 Crore rupees, and the second and third prizes were 25 lakhs and 5 lakhs, respectively. A total of 6,54,506 prizes were given to the winners. 12% of the first- to third-prize amounts will be deducted, and the remainder will be given to the agents (who sell the winning tickets) by the lottery agency. In the case of the 5th to 9th and the consolation prizes, 10% of the prize amount (agent's commission) will be deducted from the fund allotted by the government.
